email_subject: Application - Digital Learning Intern (The Academy Online)
email_body:
Dear Easyfairs Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Learning Intern position at The Academy Online. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to real learning projects that support colleagues across Europe.

At Episto, I build and maintain WordPress sites, create keyword-targeted content, and use tools like Canva and AI-assisted content tools. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed a multi-page site, implemented structured data, and produced visuals and social media content. I am comfortable turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content and am eager to apply my skills to e-learning development, video production, and AI for learning.

I am available for an internship of at least 12 weeks and would love to bring my creativity and proactive approach to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

Dear Easyfairs Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Digital Learning Intern position at The Academy Online. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am drawn to Easyfairs' commitment to continuous learning and its international, fast-paced environment. The opportunity to contribute to real projects that support employees across Europe aligns perfectly with my skills and aspirations.

At Episto, I build and maintain WordPress websites, create keyword-targeted content, and use tools like Canva and AI-assisted content tools to produce engaging visuals and copy. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and integrated social media content. These experiences have honed my ability to turn complex ideas into clear, accessible content—a skill directly applicable to creating interactive e-learning modules and learning videos. I am also comfortable exploring AI tools for content creation and am eager to learn Articulate Rise 360 and other digital learning platforms.

I am organised, proactive, and enjoy collaborating with others to achieve shared goals. My background in front-end development and SEO gives me a strong eye for structure and design, and I am confident I can quickly pick up new tools and contribute to promoting learning opportunities across Easyfairs. I am available for an internship of at least 12 weeks and would welcome the chance to bring my creativity and curiosity to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to The Academy Online.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
